name: Steakhouse Confidential Prime USDC
oneLiner: steakcUSDC is Steakhouse's public USDC vault share behind a confidential deposit surface; withdrawals use liquid USDC and losses reduce NAV.
collateral: USDC in the Steakhouse-curated Morpho Vault V2 on ethereum, held idle or lent through its MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2; borrower collateral and credit losses remain local strategy exposure
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares accrue net USDC lending interest and realize losses at NAV. Ordinary withdraw/redeem uses idle USDC and the configured liquidity adapter, subject to liquidity; force-deallocation and in-kind exits are separate, not guaranteed dollar settlement

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Steakhouse Confidential Prime USDC (steakcUSDC) at ethereum:0xbeef00a59b577423653a1526c7009bde103f542b is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0x17bc9aa135cef1a5c3a91925e0f865d526318718 holds 3 enumerated Morpho market IDs. This intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent and older Morpho precedent classifications.
